proposed_widenings.name: emit_light
proposed_widenings.justification: The item has a deterministic, toggleable dim-light state with a fixed radius, but the current effect atoms cannot represent light emission or extinguishing.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding this weapon, you can cause it to emit green Dim Light out to 10 feet ... or you can extinguish the light as a Bonus Action.

proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.item
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing alter_item_kind atom can describe a form change, but the authored surface cannot target the held weapon itself because Attachment lacks an item/object branch.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding this weapon, you can take a Bonus Action to alter its form, turning it into a 6-inch rod ... or a 10-foot pole, or reverting it a Quarterstaff.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_weapon_profile
proposed_widenings.justification: The item grants the Thrown property with explicit ranges and then returns to the wielder's hand after a ranged attack. That is a weapon-profile change plus a deterministic post-attack return behavior not covered by existing atoms.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This weapon has the Thrown property with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 120 feet. Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand.

notes: Encoded supported subset only: held-item +2 attack/damage bonus and Attack Deflection. Typecheck and tracer both passed. Acrobatic Assist was omitted because its form restriction depends on the missing item-form surface.
